policies.why.seat: Your wallet could not find your seat on this company, so nothing was filed or sent. Open the company with your wallet and try again.
policies.why.may-not-set: Your wallet will not set a spending policy from your seat: your seat's role does not set spending policies. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.may-not-set-after-filing: Your wallet stopped before sending: as it now reads the company's directory, your seat may no longer set spending policies. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.may-not-set-after-sending: Your wallet stopped: as it now reads the company's directory, your seat may no longer set spending policies. Part of the change may already have been sent, so read the company again before you try.
policies.why.seat-not-in-directory: Your wallet will not set a spending policy from your seat: the company's directory, as your wallet reads it, does not hold your seat. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.seat-not-believed: Your wallet will not set a spending policy from your seat: it does not believe your seat's entry in the company's directory. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.not-adopted: Your wallet will not set a spending policy on this vault: the company's account on the network has not adopted it yet. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.not-a-policy: That is not a spending policy. It needs four bands, each with a ceiling and at least one approval, a limit, and a period of at least one second. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.not-a-currency: The policy is for a currency your wallet does not know. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.not-a-bar: The approvals a policy change needs must be a whole number, at least one. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.too-many: A policy change cannot need more approvals than the company has signers seated. Nothing was sent.
policies.why.refused: Your wallet will not raise this change. Nothing was sent. Read the company again and try once more.
policies.why.not-raised: The change was not raised. Nothing was sent, and nothing changed.
policies.why.may-be-sent: The change stopped after it was handed over to be sent. It may have gone through, so look at the Proposals page before you try again.
policies.why.raised-not-read: The change was raised, but your wallet could not read it back from the company's records, so it was not carried further. Look for it on the Proposals page.
policies.why.not-approved: The change has not reached the approvals it needs yet.
policies.why.not-carried: The change has its approvals but was not carried out. Carry it out again from the Proposals page.
policies.why.withdrawn: This change was withdrawn, so there is nothing more to do.
policies.why.carried-out: The network has already carried this change out.
policies.why.already-counted: The network already counts your approval of this change.
policies.why.outrun: A signer was removed or replaced since this change was raised, so it cannot be carried out. Raise it again.
policies.why.not-as-shown: The proposal under that name does not change what this page showed, so nothing was done.
policies.why.stopped: Your wallet stopped before the change was finished.
policies.why.other: The change could not be finished. Look at the Proposals page to see how far it got.
policies.intro: A spending policy sets, for one vault and one currency, how many approvals a payment needs at each size and how much the vault may pay in each period. A change to it needs the approvals the company asks for, and your wallet asks for your passkey each time.
policies.noVaults: The company has no vault yet that its account has adopted, so there is nothing to set a spending policy on.
policies.noKeys: Your wallet has not opened the company on this visit, so its spending policies cannot be read yet.
policies.vault.unset: No spending policy is set on this vault.
policies.held.unread: {symbol}: this device could not open the policy.
policies.held.heading: {symbol} policy
policies.band.label: Band {n}: payments up to
policies.held.limit: The most the vault may pay in each period
policies.form.limit: The most the vault may pay in each period
policies.form.unread: What the company's account holds could not be read, so a policy cannot be set from this page now.
policies.review.heading: Before you save
policies.review.because.account: That is the number the company's account asks for.
policies.review.because.vault: That is the number {vault} asks for.
policies.warn.every-signer: This change needs every one of the {seated} signers seated. If one of them loses their key, no change of who signs, no policy change and no bar change can be made again.
policies.warn.every-signer.runs: A policy with only one band of approvals also refuses every payment run on this vault while one of them cannot approve.
policies.warn.bar-stays: The policy bar will be {bar}, above the {approvals} approvals the company's account asks for. Lowering the account's approvals later does not lower it. While it stays, every policy change and every change of who signs needs {bar} approvals.
policies.warn.bar-raised: This change raises the policy bar to {bar}. From then on every policy change and every change of who signs needs {bar} approvals.
policies.warn.bar-lowered: This change lowers the policy bar to {bar}.
policies.review.public.heading: What this change makes public on the network
policies.review.public.highest-band: The highest number of approvals any band of this policy asks for, {value}, because it raises the bar.
policies.review.public.vault-has-a-polic: That this vault has a spending policy.
policies.review.public.approval-count: How many approvals the change gets.
policies.review.hidden: The ceilings, the limit and the period are not published. A payment from this vault shows how many approvals it needed, which tells a reader which band it fell in.
policies.review.reset: Saving this policy starts its period total again from nothing, whatever the vault has already paid in the current period.
policies.bar.heading: Policy bar
policies.bar.intro: The policy bar is the number of approvals any change to a spending policy needs. It is also the least a change of who signs needs.
policies.bar.unset_one: No policy bar is set, so the company account's {count} approval applies.
policies.bar.unset_other: No policy bar is set, so the company account's {count} approvals apply.
policies.bar.unread: What the company's account holds could not be read, so the bar cannot be changed from this page now.
policies.done.carried: Done: the change is carried out.
policies.done.waiting: Raised. It waits for approvals on the {page} page.
policies.problem.not-a-policy: That is not a spending policy. It needs four bands, each with an amount of the currency, a limit, and a period. Nothing was sent.
policies.problem.not-whole: The approvals must be a whole number, at least one.
policies.problem.too-high: The bar cannot be more than the {count} signers seated.
policies.problem.unread: What the company's account holds could not be read, so nothing was sent.
